gloss: to be proportionate; to correspond; to look at each other

forms.label: ている past polite
forms.negative: {見合|みあ}っていませんでした

definitions.gloss: to be proportionate; to correspond; to be commensurate
definitions.explanation: To be appropriate or in proportion to something. Often used when discussing whether effort, cost, or quality matches expectations or value.

definitions.gloss: to look at each other; to face each other
definitions.explanation: For two people or things to look at or face one another.

examples.english: The results were commensurate with the effort.

examples.english: I checked whether the quality matched the price.

examples.english: The two looked at each other and laughed.

examples.english: Opinions were divided at the meeting, and the participants looked at each other.

notes:
{見合|みあ}う is an intransitive godan verb.

ASPECT (ている):
{見合|みあ}って⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧ indicates a state of facing each other or being proportionate.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- [thing]⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{見合|みあ}う (be proportionate to, match)
- [person]⟦と→と：00512_to⟧{見合|みあ}う (look at each other)

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{値段|ねだん}→値段：00871_nedan⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{見合|みあ}う (match the price)
- ⟦{努力|どりょく}→努力：03490_doryoku⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{見合|みあ}う (be commensurate with effort)
- ⟦{給料|きゅうりょう}→給料：01086_kyuuryou⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{見合|みあ}う (be proportionate to one's salary)
- ⟦{顔|かお}→顔：00558_kao⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{見合|みあ}わせる→見合わせる：09450_miawaseru⟧ (exchange glances)

The phrase ⟦{顔|かお}→顔：00558_kao⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{見合|みあ}わせる→見合わせる：09450_miawaseru⟧ uses the causative form and is a set expression meaning to exchange surprised or confused glances. Distinct from ⟦{見合|みあ}い→見合い：14159_miai⟧ (arranged marriage meeting), which is the noun form of a related but specialized meaning.
